Learn moreSign in Comments 16 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Dhurandhar 2 Intro Scene Kaise Shoot Hua? 🔥 Action Director Reveals BTS 1.6KLikes61,073ViewsMar 212026 In this short , Aejaz Gulab the action director of Dhurandhar 1 & 2 explains how Rangi’s journey isn’t told through long flashbacks, but through powerful moments that reflect what he feels rather than just what happened. From being an army man to facing a life-changing tragedy, the character’s transformation is driven by his perspective and inner turmoil. He shares how the team focused on showing emotions through action, expressions, and raw intensity instead of traditional storytelling. This video, gives you a closer look at how a strong character backstory is created in action films, where every scene adds depth, purpose, and impact to the narrative.
